sources.entry: Textual - Textual is an IRC client for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Textual is a customizable IRC (Internet Relay Chat) client for macOS, currently in a work-in-progress refactor toward version 8 on the main branch.
summary.what_it_does: Textual is an IRC chat client for macOS. The README says it can be customized with styles written in CSS, HTML, and JavaScript. It also states that plugins can be written in Objective-C and Swift, and scripts in AppleScript and many other languages. The main branch is being refactored toward Textual 8 and may have bugs, incomplete features, and breaking changes, so the README points users to the separate v7 branch and the website for the current release. The project has new maintainership (Blendbyte GmbH), and development continues on this repository.
use_cases: chatting on IRC from a Mac
using IRC networks such as Libera Chat
customizing chat app appearance with CSS or JavaScript styles
writing AppleScript automation for an IRC client
building Objective-C or Swift plugins for a chat client
how_to_run: Download the current release from www.textualapp.com
Read CONTRIBUTING.md for build and test instructions if building from source
notable: Styles written in CSS, HTML, and JavaScript
Scripting through AppleScript and other languages
Textual 7 source kept on the v7 branch
caveats: main branch is a work in progress toward Textual 8 and may not build or may contain serious bugs
Not recommended to use main-branch builds with settings or logs you care about
